'''Workshop A6''' was a location within the [[Troida Military Workshop]] in [[Gorinth Canyon]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] used as a base by the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] occupation of Balmorra.
